_comment: === TARGETED TEST: Constraint (13) loophole demonstration ===
Purpose: prove the original Khaled et al. (2018) Eq.(13) is vacuous when
no maintenance check has ever occurred (mega=0 at both window endpoints),
while the corrected split formulation correctly forces infeasibility.
Design: a SINGLE aircraft (0) must fly ALL 4 flights (no alternative
aircraft to redistribute load to). All 4 flights depart on day 2
(dep in [1440,2880) minutes) -- NOT day 1 -- so that constraint C13b
(existing/prior-hours window, which is always corrected-style and would
otherwise mask the bug) does not interfere; the window under test is
purely the main C13 constraint (days[0]=1 .. some later day).
Total flight time = 4 x 350 = 1400 min, exceeding the A-check
threshold of 1000 min. Station_Capacity is EMPTY (no airport can host
any maintenance), so a check can never physically be performed --
mega[0,d,'A'] = 0 for every day d.
IMPORTANT: run with use_existing_hrs=False (not exposed on the CLI;
call run_milp()/build_model() directly) to isolate the main C13
constraint from C13b. Also use enabled_checks=['A'] and
use_check_hierarchy=False to remove confounds.
Expected result:
use_paper_c13=True   : status = optimal  (bug: unlimited flight hours
allowed once mega=0 at both window endpoints)
use_paper_c13=False  : status = infeasible (correctly rejects a
schedule that flies 1400 min with a 1000 min
cap and zero maintenance opportunities)
